svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One piece cut from 12 mm plate: a 40 mm round boss and an arm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 16 mm wide reaching 122 mm from the boss centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore the boss 16 mm (a sliding fit on the rod, ream if you can).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wire eye: a 3.2 mm hole on the arm centre line, 112.4 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bore centre; break both edges so the wire cannot chafe.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw a 1.5 mm slit from the bore out through the boss on the side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clamp screw: at 14 mm from the bore centre, square across the slit,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drill 5.5 mm through the near jaw with a 9 mm spot face, and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drill 4.2 mm and tap M5 in the far jaw.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: slides on the lower rod from the top; its top face butts the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: underside of the anvil, which carries it at every blow. Turn the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: arm to point at the reel's wire exit, then tighten the M5 screw.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: slides on the rod with the screw slack; locks by hand.
